preprocessing: First difference within each run_id; then (delta - mean_train_delta) / std_train_delta; ddof=0
evaluation: MASE on reconstructed levels and common target points; shared denominator from train levels
mean_std: Per-variable mean and population std (ddof=0) of absolute scaled errors over test points
constant_series: MASE undefined for zero train denominator; report standardized MAE separately
